name: Cape Parrot
rangeDescription: Southern and eastern south africa (eastern cape and southern kwazulu-natal; isolated population at woodbush forest, limpopo)
description: Large, dark green parrot. Note the red patches on the shoulder and thighs.

name: Flame-throated Bulbul
rangeDescription: Hills of southwestern india (western mysore to kerala and tamil nadu)
description: Yellow bulbul with a black head, a bright red throat, and pale eyes. Endemic to the Western Ghats, where it can often be found in scrubby foothill forest, as well as overgrown and degraded forest edge.

name: Gray-breasted Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Arid tropical southwestern ecuador and northwestern peru
description: Small, scarce flycatcher found in both dry and humid forest in western Ecuador and northwestern Peru. Good field marks are the mostly gray plumage, white “spectacles,” and bold white wingbars.

name: Turquoise-crowned Hummingbird
rangeDescription: Southern mexico (guerrero, oaxaca, and chiapas)
description: Brilliantly-colored hummingbird with dark tail and mostly red bill. Fairly common in thorn forest within its limited range.

name: Red-faced Guan
rangeDescription: Humid andes of southeastern bolivia to far northwestern argentina
description: Mostly arboreal guan endemic to the semi-humid forest with Podocarpus and alders of the mid-elevation east Andes in southern Bolivia and northeast Argentina. Often in ravines and river basins.

name: Yucatan Gnatcatcher
rangeDescription: Southeastern mexico (far northern yucatán peninsula)
description: Tiny gray and white bird with cocked tail. Local in dry tropical scrub of northern Yucatan Peninsula.

name: Speckled Wood-Pigeon
rangeDescription: Montane forest of kashmir to india, west-central china, and myanmar
description: Uniquely colored large pigeon of mid- to high-altitude broadleaf and mixed forests. Grayish overall, with a deep maroon back, ashy gray head, chestnut streaking on the belly, and fine white spots on the upperwing.

name: Black-capped Vireo
rangeDescription: Breeds kansas to northern mexico (coahuila); winters to guerrero
description: Small vireo with distinctive black head and bold white spectacles surrounding a red eye. Otherwise greenish above with white underparts, yellowish sides and two yellow wingbars.

name: Ecuadorian Seedeater
rangeDescription: Mountains of southwestern colombia (nariño) to northern peru (cajamarca)
description: Scarce and very local. A rather plain, easily overlooked, small seed-eating bird.

name: Red-eared Parrotfinch
rangeDescription: Southern philippines (mounts katanglad and apo, mindanao)
description: A small bird of montane forest and scrub on Mindanao. Usually forages on the ground for seeds.

name: Sumba Boobook
rangeDescription: Lowlands of sumba (western lesser sundas)
description: A brown owl with a rounded head, dark eyes, brown upperparts and crown with extensive white markings, a prominent white throat, and thick brown bands on the underparts. Occupies forest, forest edge, and mangroves in the lowlands and foothills.

name: Palau Scops-Owl
rangeDescription: Lowlands of palau (western caroline islands)
description: A reddish-brown owl with a large rounded head, pale whitish eyebrows, and no ear tufts. Upperparts spotted with black-tipped white spots.

name: Writhe-billed Hornbill
rangeDescription: Central philippines (panay, guimaras, and negros)
description: A large rare bird of lowland and foothill forest on Panay and Negros, although almost extinct on the latter. Mostly black with a cream-colored tail with black terminal band, an orange casque, and a wrinkled lower bill.

name: Morrison's Fulvetta
rangeDescription: Taiwan
description: Active small songbird, endemic to Taiwan. Brown above, white below, with gray head, large white eyering, thin black borders in crown (hard to see at times), and buffy wash in flanks.

name: White-throated Manakin
rangeDescription: Southern venezuela to the guianas and northeastern amazonian brazil
description: Tiny, inconspicuous manakin of lowland rainforest canopy. Adult male is unmistakable; females and young males are told by slim shape and crisp two-toned appearance.

name: Oilbird
rangeDescription: Locally from panama and northern south america including trinidad to western bolivia
description: This bizarre nocturnal fruit-eating bird is unlikely to be mistaken. It is entirely rufous-brown with small white spots on the wings, tail, and body.

name: Reiser's Tyrannulet
rangeDescription: Interior eastern brazil (piauí) to northeastern paraguay
description: Small, yellow-green flycatcher. Note the white lores and gray crown.

name: Black-faced Spoonbill
rangeDescription: Breeds northeastern china and korea; winters to southeastern asia
description: Large white waterbird with a long spatula-shaped bill. Breeding adults have long plumes on the head and a smudging of yellow on the chest.

name: Pied Stilt
rangeDescription: Indonesia to australia and new zealand; winters to philippines
description: Large black-and-white shorebird with long straight, needle-like bill, and very long pink legs. Note black hind-neck.

name: Blue Paradise-Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Southwestern philippines (calamian group and palawan)
description: A medium-sized, long-tailed bird of lowland forest understory on Palawan and neighboring islands. Has a blue bill, eye-ring, chest, and head with a slight crest at the back.
